testing_requirements.data_testid: ALL interactive elements (window buttons, dock items, terminal input, recruiter toggle, form inputs, submit button, navigation links) MUST include explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a cohesive React single page application with desktop OS view at '/' and recruiter traditional portfolio view at '/recruiter'.
Use Framer Motion for window dragging, minimize, maximize, close, and dock interactions.
Implement full terminal state handling supporting 'sudo hire divyansh' Easter egg.
Ensure dark mode colors `#080B12`, `#101521`, `#141B29`, `#00F0FF` (cyan) and `#8B5CF6` (violet) are strictly applied in default OS view.
Provide a smooth Recruiter Mode toggle button in the top status bar so recruiters can instantly switch to a clean traditional portfolio with Light/Dark theme toggle.
Ensure all buttons and inputs have proper `data-testid` attributes.
